gloss: along the way; on the road; while walking

definitions.gloss: along the way; on the road; while walking
definitions.explanation: While traveling along a road or path. Describes something done or observed during a journey. A literary and somewhat elegant expression.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}すがら{花|はな}を{眺|なが}めた。
examples.english: I admired the flowers along the way.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}すがら{友人|ゆうじん}にばったり{会|あ}った。
examples.english: I happened to run into a friend on the way.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}までの{道|みち}すがら、{昔|むかし}のことをあれこれ{思|おも}い{出|だ}した。
examples.english: On the way to the station, I recalled various memories from the past.

notes:
A literary adverb with an elegant, slightly old-fashioned feel. More evocative than the everyday {途中|とちゅう}で (on the way). Often appears in essays, fiction, and travel writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {途中|とちゅう}で — on the way (neutral, everyday)
- {道|みち}すがら — along the way (literary, evocative)
- {道中|どうちゅう} — during a journey (slightly formal)

The すがら element is a classical particle meaning "while; along" and is not productive in modern Japanese.
